title: Prime Minister congratulates Mr. Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva on his victory in the presidential elections in Brazil
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today extended his heartiest congratulations to Mr. Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva on his victory in the presidential elections in Brazil. Shri Modi expressed eagerness to work closely with him to further deepen and expand the multifaceted India-Brazil Strategic Partnership. He emphasized that together, both nations will continue to strengthen cooperation across diverse sectors, advance the shared priorities of the Global South, and work towards a more inclusive, equitable, and sustainable world. In a post on X, the Prime Minister shared: "Heartiest congratulations to my dear friend, President Lula, on his remarkable re-election victory. I look forward to working closely with him to further deepen and expand the multifaceted India-Brazil Strategic Partnership. Together, we will continue to strengthen our cooperation across diverse sectors, advance the shared priorities of the Global South and work towards a more inclusive, equitable and sustainable world. @LulaOficial" Heartiest congratulations to my dear friend, President Lula, on his remarkable re-election victory.

I look forward to working closely with him to further deepen and expand the multifaceted India-Brazil Strategic Partnership.

Together, we will continue to strengthen our cooperation across diverse sectors, advance the shared priorities of the Global South and work towards a more inclusive, equitable and sustainable world.
